title: US oil firm HKN aims to double output in Syria's formerly Kurdish-run fields
gist: Texas-based HKN Energy, the first US company to officially invest in Syria via a 25-year deal with the Syrian Petroleum Company, aims to double output at eight formerly Kurdish-run fields near Rmeilan while tackling pollution. It partners with Qatar's UCC Holding but will be sole operator, as the future of the Kurdish-run Jazira Oil Company remains unclear.
